description: This file defines the repository interface DelinquencyRangeRepository for accessing DelinquencyRange entities from the database, using Spring Data JPA. It extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide CRUD operations and query execution capabilities, including a custom method findByClassification.

classes.name: DelinquencyRangeRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for DelinquencyRange entity, providing data access methods.

methods.name: findByClassification
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the DelinquencyRange entity matching the given classification.
